📖 How to use

  1. Enter current savings, monthly contribution and years until college.
  2. Set an expected annual return and the target college cost.
  3. Read the projected value and the funding shortfall.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the projection calculated?

Future value = current savings grown with interest + future value of the monthly contribution annuity. Both compound at the assumed annual return.

How do monthly contributions compound?

The contribution annuity is assumed to be paid monthly and to compound monthly at the annual return ÷ 12.

What return should I assume?

Returns are never guaranteed. Try a lower (conservative) and higher (optimistic) return to see a range of outcomes.
